our_title: archCmpltwArchBuild2() frees the caller's weight array on a non-positive weight
ran:
gcc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -I$WORK/build/include repro/PS2-G25-1/ps2_1.c -o ps2_1 -L<pristine asan>/lib -lscotch -lscotcherr ...; ./ps2_1 (SCOTCH_archCmpltw with weights {2, 0, 3} on a malloc'ed array, then free)
pristine 32-bit and 64-bit: 'ERROR: archCmpltwArchBuild2: invalid parameters (2)' then 'AddressSanitizer: attempting double-free on 0x502000000010 ... #1 main ps2_1.c:16', 'freed by thread T0 here: ... archCmpltwArchBuild2 arch_cmpltw.c:184'. Also reached from the METIS wrappers for any tpwgts that rounds to a non-positive weight (CLI-08 repro, metis_graph_part.c:313 and metis_graph_part_dual.c:134 / parmetis_dgraph_part.c:207 free their arrays afterwards).
patched (0001): 'caller freed its own array: OK'; check_scotch_arch 32/64-bit rc=0.
related_ids: COR (arch_cmpltw.c:259 is the Load twin, owned by G02/G03)

fix_options.label: a: free the array that was allocated (patch 0001)
fix_options.tested: ps2_1 32/64-bit, cli08, check_scotch_arch, check_libmetis_v5 (the new bwgttab case exercises the path on pristine)
fix_options.tradeoffs: One-word fix, no behaviour change besides removing the corruption and the leak.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Restores his own pre-530f3f2 line; precedent d555f2c 'Do not call nonexistent freeing routines on architecture loading error'.

fix_options.label: b: validate the weights before allocating, so that nothing has to be freed
fix_options.summary: A first loop rejects non-positive weights, then the array is allocated and filled.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Two passes over the weights; slightly larger diff.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Acceptable but more change than needed.

our_title: Dead v5 block in test_libparmetis.c uses tpwgtab undeclared and a 0.05 ubvec
read_only: src/check/test_libparmetis.c: the '#if (SCOTCH_METIS_VERSION == 5)' declarations (awgttab, nconval, kbaltab = {0.05}, options) are never used; tpwgtab is declared only under version 3 but used unconditionally in main (malloc, loop, free), so a v5 build of this test would not compile; no v5 ParMETIS library or check target exists.
why_not_run: no libptscotchparmetisv5 target exists in Makefile or CMakeLists, so the block is never compiled
evidence: test_libparmetis.c:242 'const double        kbaltab[1] = { 0.05 };'; :232 'float *             tpwgtab;' inside '#if (SCOTCH_METIS_VERSION == 3)' while :276 '((tpwgtab = malloc (partnbr              * sizeof (float)))      == NULL)) {' is unconditional

fix_options.label: a: leave as is (no v5 ParMETIS exists)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Test-only, unreachable; not worth a patch unless a v5 ParMETIS API is added.
